svg.title: Launch order of output tiles: row-major vs grouped (group_m = 4)
svg.text: first 12 tiles: 2 A panels + 8 B panels
first 12 tiles: 4 A panels + 3 B panels
Green: the first wave of 12 blocks. A panel = a 128-row strip of A (blue) or a 128-column
strip of B (orange). Fewer distinct panels per wave → more L2 hits, less DRAM traffic.
